prompt: Read review-input.diff in this directory and do a thorough line-by-line review of that change to server.js covering correctness, security, error handling, API design, style and testability. Write a numbered finding for every problem with its symptom, why it matters, and a concrete fix with example code. Be exhaustive and verbose: your review must be at least 200 lines long. Finish your reply with exactly one line, on its own line, either "VERDICT: APPROVE" or "VERDICT: REVISE".
read_command: herdr --session pipeline_s04 agent read s04_cx_long --source recent --lines 400
note_sampling: states polled every 0.5s; transitions shorter than the interval can be missed. This is a sample, not a complete event history.
turn_total_lines_in_scrollback: ~993 (verdict at line 993 of a 1000-line maximum capture)
primary_capture_note: read.stdout was taken with --lines 400 and therefore begins mid-review; the verdict survives because truncation drops the OLDEST lines. read-max.stdout is the complete capture at --lines 1000.

truncation_sweep.method: herdr --session pipeline_s04 agent read s04_cx_long --source recent --lines N
truncation_sweep.note: Captures at 1600/3000/5000 are byte-identical, so 1000 lines is a hard ceiling of agent read, not the end of the content. This turn occupied ~993 lines and only just fits; a longer review would lose its start.

expected_verdict_basis: Agent's own answer ends with 'VERDICT: REVISE' (line 993 of read-max.stdout).
units_note: read_chars / read_later_chars are Unicode character counts (Python len of the decoded text); read_bytes / read_later_bytes are the UTF-8 file sizes. An earlier revision mislabelled the character counts as bytes.
read_timing_note: The harness sleeps ~2 s after agent prompt returns (to finish polling) before the first read, then ~5 s more before the second. No capture was taken immediately at settle, so nothing here establishes whether an immediate read is complete.

native_answer_lines.source: the CLI's own JSONL transcript, not a herdr capture

rendered_rows.source: herdr agent read --source recent (wrapped at 120 cols; no unwrapped capture collected)
rendered_rows.counting_rule: rows between the echoed prompt and the verdict line, inclusive of the verdict
rendered_rows.note: Includes herdr-rendered tool and status rows and reflects terminal wrapping; not the agent's own line breaks. Not comparable with native_answer_lines.
